For, an adaptation of current cybernetic into cybernetic pedagogy as cognitive modelling within a compounded educational system is proposed.\"}, {\"id\": \"https://openalex.org/W7128148425\", \"doi\": null, \"title\": \"A Defense of Focō, Ergo Volō: \\\"I Focus, therefore I Will\\\"\", \"publication_year\": 2025, \"type\": \"book\", \"cited_by_count\": 0, \"open_access\": {\"is_oa\": true, \"oa_status\": \"green\", \"oa_url\": \"https://philpapers.org/archive/FERADO-6.pdf\", \"any_repository_has_fulltext\": true}, \"primary_location\": {\"id\": \"pmh:oai:philpapers.org/rec/FERADO-6\", \"doi\": null, \"is_oa\": true, \"landing_page_url\": \"https://philpapers.org/rec/FERADO-6\", \"pdf_url\": \"https://philpapers.org/archive/FERADO-6.pdf\", \"source\": {\"id\": \"https://openalex.org/S4306402130\", \"display_name\": \"PhilPapers (PhilPapers Foundation)\", \"issn_l\": null, \"issn\": null, \"is_oa\": false, \"is_in_doaj\": false, \"is_core\": false, \"listed_in\": [], \"host_organization\": null, \"host_organization_name\": null, \"host_organization_lineage\": [], \"host_organization_lineage_names\": [], \"type\": \"repository\"}, \"license\": null, \"license_id\": null, \"version\": \"submittedVersion\", \"is_accepted\": false, \"is_published\": false, \"raw_source_name\": null, \"raw_type\": \"info:eu-repo/semantics/book\"}, \"abstract\": \"Four centuries ago, Descartes introduced \\\"I think, therefore I am,\\\" in the Cogito which secured a foundation for the certainty of knowing, but left the structure of agency without an equivalent point of origin. This book argues that such a foundation exists, and that it is revealed in the most elemental feature of lived experience, which is the ability to direct one’s own focus. Before intention or choice, before deliberation or desire, there is the self-evident act of orienting awareness, and from this act emerges a new first principle articulated in the axiom Focō, ergo volō, \\\"I focus therefore I will\\\". This axiom is not a metaphysical posit and it is not an empirical conjecture. It stands in the transcendental register where its truth is demonstrated in the very effort to examine or deny it, for any attempt to assess the claim already performs the act it identifies. The capacity to locate, shift or withhold attention is the primordial gesture through which an agent discloses itself as the source of its own activity.
